purpose: AR client, invoice pages: a service for /api/v1/ar-invoices and /api/v1/ar-invoiced-shipments whose commands send Idempotency-Key equal to body.eventId; an invoice list with URL-restored filters; an invoice detail that shows the server totalAmount rather than a line sum, line amounts without rounding and sales-unit quantities and, with fulfillment.view, links from lines to their shipments, with confirm, cancel and void through the existing useCommandEvent (an uncertain outcome retries the same eventId); and a create-from-shipments page that lists SHIPPED shipments, marks those already invoiced, limits the selection to one customer and 20 shipments, and locks the form while an outcome is uncertain. menu.js gains the accountsReceivable group these pages declare. The receipt UI follow-up displays an em dash for outstanding amounts on voided or cancelled invoices in both the list and details. G1 covers opening invoice customer lookup and registration, the dedicated permission, stale customer selection, and retrying an uncertain submission with the same payload and event ID.
data: No database or network: mocked services and real discovered pages, with inline objects of at most 4 shipments, 2 invoice lines and 1 invoice. No fixture files. No database or network.

trigger: Existing ci.yml triggers and discovery only, in the existing client test job: admitted PR dispatch, push to main and the existing weekly schedule. No new job, step, schedule or dispatch. No capacity or performance workload.
cost: Local run of the 3 new files: 23 cases in about 0.3 s of test time (about 1.1 s wall). Not measured in CI. No new job.
